finding_disposition.finding: UI/storage baseline agreement and restoration after failed reload
finding_disposition.evidence: The runner refuses a baseline unless the active Privacy switch and matrx.settings.v1 agree. Its finally path reloads, reopens Privacy, uses trusted switch clicks to reconcile UI and storage, checks the original state, and reloads again to verify persistence. The runner-boundary tests exercise mismatched baseline, failed first reload with recovery, and failed cleanup click.

finding_disposition.finding: Predicate-only fabricated tests do not guard runner orchestration
finding_disposition.evidence: The tests now invoke runGuestPrivacySwitchCase with controlled panel operations. They assert exact switch label, both click transitions, four reload calls on success, refusal before click, rejection of ignored click, recovery after reload failure, and failure of unsuccessful restoration. The focused package script includes this test file.
